# entrepot_service_account_token (Resource)

An API token (`ent_…`) for a service account. Tokens cannot be changed: changing any attribute revokes the token and issues a new one.

The token value (`secret`) is returned by the server only when the token is created and is stored in the Terraform state — protect the state accordingly. After `terraform import` the secret is unknown (null); replace the token (e.g. with `-replace`) to obtain a new secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "entrepot_service_account_token" "ci" {
  service_account = entrepot_service_account.ci.name
  name            = "github-actions"
  scopes          = ["read", "write"]
  expires_in_days = 90
}

# The token value is only known when Terraform creates the token, and is
# stored (sensitive) in the state.
output "ci_token" {
  value     = entrepot_service_account_token.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Token name (shown in the UI and audit log). Changing it forces a new token.
- `service_account` (String) Name of the service account (without the `sa:` prefix), e.g. `entrepot_service_account.ci.name`. Changing it forces a new token.

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Lifetime in days; omit for a token that never expires. Only used at creation (not returned by the API, so null after import; setting it on an imported token just records the value). Changing it forces a new token. The token is not renewed automatically when it expires: replace it.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Restrict the token to these actions (`read`, `write`, `delete`, `admin`) on top of the service account's role bindings. Omit for an unrestricted token (the attribute is then empty), unless the provider itself authenticates with a scoped token, in which case the server copies its scopes. Changing it forces a new token.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry time (RFC 3339); null for no expiry.
- `hint` (String) Non-secret abbreviation of the token, e.g. `ent_AbCd…wXyZ`.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned token ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The token value, for `Authorization: Bearer` or as a package-client password. Only known when Terraform created the token (null after import).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Tokens are imported as <service_account>/<token_id>. The secret cannot be
# recovered: after import it is null; replace the token to get a new one.
terraform import entrepot_service_account_token.ci ci/8d0c2a54-1f7e-4b61-a0c9-5e3f6d2b7a41
```
